supporting_observations.claim: A large outbound transfer of approximately 640 MB occurred from FILE-NWD-01 to PROXY-NWD-01 (10.40.20.30) on port 8080 at 13:45 UTC.
The transfer is consistent with the approved offsite backup service (stratosafe-backup.com), which is known to upload several hundred MB from FILE-NWD-01.
The transfer occurred over the organization's explicit web proxy (PROXY-NWD-01) on the approved port 8080.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon logs from FILE-NWD-01 are missing between 13:30 and 14:10 UTC due to a collection outage.
claims_not_established: The specific destination URL of the HTTP transfer cannot be confirmed due to the absence of proxy logs during the outage.
unrelated_findings: Nora Blake initiated an RDP session to FILE-NWD-01 (T040-00098, T040-00103), which deviates from the policy that remote administration is only done from WS-SOKAFOR-01.
A registry modification on FILE-NWD-01 disabled real-time monitoring for Windows Defender at 14:17 UTC (T040-00457).
